sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Antiviral reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 9. The compound sofosbuvir was discussed with target NS5B in the context of hepatitis C. The example mutation is S282T. A demonstration IC50 measurement of 682 nM is shown for Hepatitis C virus. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0009 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0009.
